propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in review-bot process; every other host that resolves attested gates populates the snapshot store without reclamation, leaving unbounded storage

Operation-linked GC trigger must avoid long-lock pitfall by using detached-child pattern: O(1) in-process check on gate-resolution tail, heavy GC pass in detached child with stamped worker-lock and gc flock sidecars
Trigger check on gate-resolution tail performs one stat of last-pass.stamp against janitor interval_seconds cadence, never acquires ticket-store lock, never raises into the gate

Single-flight coordination via stamped worker.lock sidecar keyed on per-host snapshot store root, with overlap against review-bot's resident janitor handled gracefully (skipped="locked") and stamp only recorded on successful pass

A non-review-bot host running attested gates without the review-bot server now reclaims its snapshot store via spawned detached run_gc pass when due, with durable cwd anchored at snapshot store root and stdio detached
